quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on his 62-point game and poor shooting stretch
quotes.excerpt: I was having a bad stretch of shooting up to that. I only had 16 points at half.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Do you feel that was your best game? You felt like that was your best game, or you had...

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: No. I didn't think it was my best game at all. What was crazy was I was having a bad stretch of shooting up to that. Even in the first half, I only had 16 points at half. We were down 20.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on drinking alcohol before a game
quotes.excerpt: I've never drank before a game in my life. It was New Year's. So I did have a drink.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: How did you feel in the second half?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I will say this, I've never drank before a game in my life. It was New Year's. So I did have a drink, a few drinks the night before the game. Never done that in my career, haven't done it since. So I tell people that was probably what allowed me to have the night I had.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on his mindset during his 62-point game
quotes.excerpt: My thing was just let's make it close. I'm going to be a little more aggressive.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Coming out of the third quarter, you said what?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Let's make it close. Let's get it close. I'm going to be a little more aggressive. But let's just get the game close within maybe 10 at the fourth quarter. They were rolling. They were playing well. It was when they had Zach, Amar'e, Alex Caruso, all them guys, IO, Vucevic. So they were playing well. Next thing you know, the first shot starts going in, now I'm able to get to the rim, now I'm scoring, now the shots that I've been missing for the past week are starting to fall.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on his baseball background and father's influence
quotes.excerpt: My dad worked for the Mets, so every spring break, that's where I was.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: When did you fall in love with baseball?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: My whole life. My dad worked for the Mets, so every spring break, that's where I was. I was at spring training. It was me down there with Jose Reyes, David Wright, Pedro Martinez, and I'm taking batting practice. I'm in the bullpen sessions. I'm in the locker room all the summers. He's coaching in the minor leagues, so I'm traveling with guys. Jacob deGrom wasn't Jacob deGrom at that time, he was my dad coached him. So I was around him a lot, which then he turned out to be who he is, which I think is pretty dope.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on why he switched from baseball to basketball
quotes.excerpt: I hurt myself, I broke my wrist, and then next thing you know, I just was like, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: So how did basketball creep in?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I hurt myself, I broke my wrist, and then next thing you know, I just was like, man. You know when you play it for so long as a kid, you just kind of get tired of it. I was around it for so long. And then next thing you know, I was just like, man, I want to hoop. And that year I went from three offers basketball-wise to the next year I went to Brewster Academy, I had 26.
